about_the_game:
An all new heroine type, the "Unhealthily Obsessed Yamato Nadeshiko" (a.k.a. Yandere) makes her appearance in Custom Order Maid 3D2! 

This Personality Pack lets you hire a "Yandere" maid in the same way you would a "Muku," "Majime," or "Rindere" maid.

～Who is this Unhealthily Obsessed Yamato Nadeshiko?～

Although she has a few problems regarding romance, outside of matters of love and hate she's a traditional girl who is kind, thoughtful, and polite. However, she is pathologically obsessed with the person she loves. She gets extremely jealous of anyone close to her partner, and may act out of line. She loves her partner deeply and intensely, but an insincere lover will experience the full extent of her fury… and her shackles.

• You can enjoy training, job communication, and scenes as a maid working in the Empire Club with Yandere!

• Playable events are available before becoming a lover with Yandere, such as a love story and events where Yandere interacts with other maids!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains adult content intended for individuals 18 years of age or older.
It includes nudity, sex scenes, and blatantly sexual imagery, as well as imagery that has sexual implications. Some scenes may be interpreted as non-consensual sex. Please be advised that there are BDSM scenes in this DLC. If you are uncomfortable with the above content, we recommend you refrain from playing.
If you are not yet 18+ or if you are accessing from any country or located where adult material is specifically prohibited by law, do not play this game.
